genres.name: Neo-Soul
genres.description: 1990s conscious return to acoustic Black music in the age of sampling. Real instruments, jazz harmony, confessional lyrics.
genres.will_response: home base — already knew this world

genres.name: British Folk
genres.description: 1960s-70s UK acoustic tradition. Less protest than American folk, more ache. Fingerpicked guitar, close-mic'd voice.
genres.will_response: new discovery — the intimacy and guitar work drew him in

genres.name: Celtic Soul / Irish Folk-Soul
genres.description: Irish and Scottish folk meeting soul and jazz. Less protest, more mysticism. Van Morrison is the defining figure.
genres.will_response: highlight — confirmed on the right track with Irish/Scottish sound

genres.name: Flamenco
genres.description: Andalusian Roma tradition. Guitar, voice (cantaor), handclaps (palmas), footwork (zapateado). Emotional directness bordering on exorcism.
genres.will_response: loved — pure forms especially. Flamenco is awesome.

genres.name: Nuevo Flamenco
genres.description: Paco de Lucía's invention — flamenco absorbing jazz, Brazilian, and rock elements without losing its soul.

genres.name: Fado
genres.description: Portuguese tradition built around saudade — untranslatable longing. Portuguese 12-string guitar + voice.
genres.will_response: loved — emotional one-two with Paco de Lucía

genres.name: Bossa Nova
genres.description: Brazilian jazz-samba fusion. Whispered vocals, jazz harmony, nylon-string guitar. The quietest revolution in music history.
genres.will_response: liked — Girl From Ipanema as familiar anchor

genres.name: Dream Folk / Dream Pop
genres.description: American atmospheric folk. Hazy production, voice at a distance, warmth without focus. Mazzy Star as the defining contemporary act.
genres.will_response: immediate resonance — Look On Down From The Bridge caught his ear randomly

concepts.name: Nylon-String Guitar Warmth
concepts.description: The sonic quality that started this entire exploration. Nylon strings produce softer, rounder, warmer tone than steel — more sustain, less attack. Used in classical, flamenco, bossa nova. Santana's tone on To Zion is the reference point.

concepts.name: Saudade
concepts.description: Portuguese concept — untranslatable longing for something you can't name or get back. The emotional core of fado.

concepts.name: Duende
concepts.description: Flamenco concept — the dark, irrational force that makes great flamenco feel like something beyond technique. Cannot be manufactured.

concepts.name: Controlled Comfortable Chaos
concepts.description: Will's phrase for what he loves in To Zion and Diablo Rojo — music that has energy and complexity but feels emotionally coherent rather than overwhelming.
